title: Robot vacuum with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='38' ry='8' fill='#2a2a4a'/>
  <!-- main body - rounded disc -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='36' ry='22' fill='#4a6fa5'/>
  <!-- top surface -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='36' ry='22' fill='#5b8dd6'/>
  <!-- highlight on top -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='54' rx='30' ry='16' fill='#7ab3f0'/>
  <!-- face screen area -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='56' rx='22' ry='14' fill='#1a2a45'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='53' r='4' fill='#5ef0c0'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='53' r='4' fill='#5ef0c0'/>
  <!-- eye shine -->
  <circle cx='43.5' cy='51.5' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='59.5' cy='51.5' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M41 60 Q50 68 59 60' stroke='#5ef0c0' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- blush -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='60' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#f08a8a' opacity='0.7'/>
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='60' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#f08a8a' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- bumper ring - darker blue -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='36' ry='22' fill='none' stroke='#3a5a8a' stroke-width='4'/>
  <!-- side wheel hint left -->
  <rect x='14' y='64' width='6' height='10' rx='3' fill='#2a2a3a'/>
  <!-- side wheel hint right -->
  <rect x='80' y='64' width='6' height='10' rx='3' fill='#2a2a3a'/>
  <!-- sensor dot on front -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='74' r='3' fill='#ffcc44'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='74' r='1.5' fill='#ffee88'/>
  <!-- dust bin lid detail -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='46' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#4a6fa5'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='45' rx='6' ry='3.5' fill='#6a9ae0'/>
</svg>
